scope: User says this lists all leader-board nodes that may affect score bonus, excluding power nodes. This is not a full account-board export.

scoreSupport.stackingRule: Unverified; the arithmetic sum is not itself an observed bonus or verified multiplier.

judgement.evaluationEffect: Unverified; actual judgement distribution and contribution to formation-detail bonus are unknown.

singerSupport.evaluationContext: W/X song-selection context requested; do not add 24 unconditionally.

provenance.timing: Newly documented here does not mean newly unlocked or changed since earlier measurements.

comparisonCaveat: W Ririka leader to X Kanade leader changes the leader character and potentially its boards as well as the costume. It is not a board-controlled costume-only experiment.

kanadeLeaderBoard.status: Requested; pending user details. Historical Kanade active-rate nodes 15/5 are member-board inputs, not a confirmed leader-board inventory.
